task1.title: Complaint About Noisy Neighbors
task1.prompt: Write an email to your building manager about a noise problem from the apartment above you.
task1.situation: You live in an apartment and the tenants above you have been making excessive noise late at night for the past two weeks. This is affecting your sleep and work performance.
bulletPoints: Describe the noise problem and when it occurs
Explain how it is affecting you
State what you have already tried to resolve the issue
Request specific action from the building manager

task1.title: Thank You to a Colleague
task1.prompt: Write an email to a colleague who helped you with a major project at work.
task1.situation: A colleague stayed late several evenings to help you complete an important presentation for a client. The presentation was very successful and your manager praised both of you.
bulletPoints: Express your gratitude for their help
Mention specific things they did that made a difference
Share the positive outcome of the presentation
Suggest doing something to celebrate

task1.title: Request for Time Off
task1.prompt: Write an email to your supervisor requesting time off from work.
task1.situation: You need to take a week off next month for a family event in another city. You have not taken any vacation days this year and your workload is currently manageable.
bulletPoints: State the dates you need off and the reason
Explain how your work will be covered in your absence
Mention your current workload status
Ask for approval and offer to discuss further

task1.title: Invitation to a Housewarming Party
task1.prompt: Write an email to a friend inviting them to your housewarming party.
task1.situation: You recently moved into a new home and want to host a housewarming party next Saturday evening. You want your friend to come and also bring their partner.
bulletPoints: Share the exciting news about your new home
Provide party details (date, time, address)
Mention what to expect at the party
Ask them to confirm if they can attend

task1.title: Complaint About a Product
task1.prompt: Write an email to a company about a defective product you purchased.
task1.situation: You bought a laptop online two weeks ago. It arrived with a cracked screen and the keyboard is not working properly. You have the receipt and warranty information.
bulletPoints: Identify the product and when/where you purchased it
Describe the specific defects
Explain what resolution you expect (replacement or refund)
Provide your contact information for follow-up

task1.title: Recommendation for a Restaurant
task1.prompt: Write an email to a friend recommending a restaurant you recently visited.
task1.situation: You went to a new restaurant in your neighborhood last weekend and had an amazing dining experience. Your friend mentioned they are looking for a good place to celebrate their anniversary.
bulletPoints: Describe the restaurant and its atmosphere
Mention what you ordered and the food quality
Explain why it would be perfect for their anniversary
Suggest making a reservation and offer to share the details

task1.title: Request for Information About a Course
task1.prompt: Write an email to a community college asking about a professional development course.
task1.situation: You saw an advertisement for an evening course in project management at a local community college. You want to know about the schedule, fees, prerequisites, and certification upon completion.
bulletPoints: Mention where you saw the advertisement
Ask about the course schedule and duration
Inquire about fees and any available financial aid
Ask about prerequisites and certification

task1.title: Apology to a Friend
task1.prompt: Write an email to a friend apologizing for missing their birthday party.
task1.situation: You missed your close friend's birthday party last weekend because you had to work overtime on an emergency project. You feel terrible because you had promised to be there.
bulletPoints: Apologize sincerely for missing the party
Explain why you could not attend
Express how you feel about the situation
Suggest a way to make it up to them

task1.title: Complaint About Public Transit
task1.prompt: Write an email to the city transit authority about poor bus service on your route.
task1.situation: The bus on your daily commute route has been consistently late or cancelled for the past month. This has caused you to be late for work several times and you have had to spend extra money on taxis.
bulletPoints: Identify your route and the time you typically travel
Describe the frequency and nature of the problems
Explain the impact on your daily life
Request improvements or compensation

task1.title: Welcome New Team Member
task1.prompt: Write an email to a new colleague who is joining your team next week.
task1.situation: A new team member is starting in your department next Monday. You have been asked to be their buddy for the first month to help them settle in. You want to introduce yourself and offer help.
bulletPoints: Introduce yourself and your role
Welcome them to the team
Describe what to expect on their first day
Offer your help and suggest meeting for coffee

task1.title: Request to Change Gym Membership
task1.prompt: Write an email to your gym asking to change your membership plan.
task1.situation: You currently have a premium membership at your gym but your work schedule has changed and you can only go in the mornings. You want to switch to a cheaper off-peak membership plan.
bulletPoints: State your current membership type and ID
Explain why you want to change plans
Specify which plan you want to switch to
Ask about any fees or procedures for the change

task1.title: Declining a Social Invitation
task1.prompt: Write an email to a friend explaining why you cannot attend their weekend camping trip.
task1.situation: Your friend invited you on a camping trip this weekend. You would love to go but you have committed to volunteering at a community charity event that you organized months ago.
bulletPoints: Thank them for the invitation
Explain why you cannot attend
Express your disappointment about missing it
Suggest an alternative plan for the future

task1.title: Report a Safety Issue at Work
task1.prompt: Write an email to your company's health and safety officer about a hazard in the workplace.
task1.situation: You noticed that the emergency exit on the second floor of your office building has been blocked by storage boxes for several days. The fire extinguisher nearby is also past its inspection date.
bulletPoints: Describe the safety hazards you observed
Specify the exact location of the problems
Explain why this is urgent
Request immediate action and a response

task1.title: Request for a Reference Letter
task1.prompt: Write an email to a former professor asking for a reference letter.
task1.situation: You are applying for a graduate program and need an academic reference. You took two courses with this professor last year and received excellent grades. The application deadline is in three weeks.
bulletPoints: Remind them of who you are and which courses you took
Explain what you are applying for
Mention the deadline and any specific requirements
Express gratitude and offer to provide additional information

task1.title: Suggesting a Workplace Improvement
task1.prompt: Write an email to your manager suggesting an improvement to the office environment.
task1.situation: You think the office would benefit from a dedicated quiet workspace for employees who need to concentrate on complex tasks. Currently, the open-plan office makes it difficult to focus during busy periods.
bulletPoints: Describe the current problem with noise levels
Propose your solution for a quiet workspace
Explain the benefits for productivity and employee satisfaction
Suggest how it could be implemented

task2.title: Remote Work vs Office Work
task2.prompt: Respond to a survey about whether companies should allow employees to work from home permanently.
task2.topic: The future of remote work in professional settings
task2.instructions: Choose one of the viewpoints below or present your own. Support your choice with reasons and examples.
viewpoints: Companies should allow full-time remote work as it improves work-life balance and productivity
Employees should return to the office as in-person collaboration is essential for innovation
A hybrid model with some days remote and some in-office is the best approach

task2.title: Social Media and Young People
task2.prompt: Respond to a survey about whether social media use should be restricted for teenagers.
task2.topic: The impact of social media on teenagers' mental health and development
task2.instructions: Choose one of the viewpoints below or present your own. Support your choice with reasons and examples.
viewpoints: Social media should be banned for children under 16 to protect their mental health
Parents should monitor usage but not restrict it, as social media is part of modern life
Schools should teach responsible social media use as part of the curriculum

task2.title: Public Transportation Funding
task2.prompt: Respond to a survey about how the city should improve public transportation.
task2.topic: Priorities for public transit investment in growing cities
task2.instructions: Choose one of the viewpoints below or present your own. Support your choice with reasons and examples.
viewpoints: The city should invest in expanding bus routes to underserved neighborhoods
Building a new subway line would be the most effective long-term solution
The city should invest in making existing services more reliable and frequent

task2.title: University Education Value
task2.prompt: Respond to a survey about whether university education is still worth the cost.
task2.topic: The value of traditional university education in the modern economy
task2.instructions: Choose one of the viewpoints below or present your own. Support your choice with reasons and examples.
viewpoints: University education is essential for career success and personal growth
Trade schools and vocational training offer better value for many students
Online courses and self-learning can replace traditional university for many fields

task2.title: Green Spaces in Cities
task2.prompt: Respond to a survey about whether the city should convert parking lots into parks.
task2.topic: Balancing urban green space with parking and development needs
task2.instructions: Choose one of the viewpoints below or present your own. Support your choice with reasons and examples.
viewpoints: Converting parking lots to parks improves community health and property values
Parking is already scarce and removing lots would harm local businesses
The city should build underground parking and create parks above

task2.title: Plastic Bag Ban
task2.prompt: Respond to a survey about whether single-use plastic bags should be completely banned.
task2.topic: Environmental policy on single-use plastics in retail
task2.instructions: Choose one of the viewpoints below or present your own. Support your choice with reasons and examples.
viewpoints: A complete ban is necessary to protect the environment
A small fee per bag is a better approach as it gives consumers choice
Focus should be on improving recycling programs rather than banning products

task2.title: Community Sports Programs
task2.prompt: Respond to a survey about how the community center should allocate its sports budget.
task2.topic: Priorities for community sports and recreation funding
task2.instructions: Choose one of the viewpoints below or present your own. Support your choice with reasons and examples.
viewpoints: Priority should be given to youth programs to keep children active and healthy
Adult fitness programs should receive more funding as adults pay the majority of taxes
Senior-focused programs are most needed as they improve health outcomes for an aging population

task2.title: Technology in Classrooms
task2.prompt: Respond to a survey about whether students should be allowed to use tablets instead of textbooks.
task2.topic: Digital devices replacing traditional learning materials in schools
task2.instructions: Choose one of the viewpoints below or present your own. Support your choice with reasons and examples.
viewpoints: Tablets should replace textbooks as they are interactive and always up to date
Traditional textbooks are better for learning and do not cause screen fatigue
A combination of both digital and print materials provides the best learning experience

task2.title: Immigration and Local Economy
task2.prompt: Respond to a survey about the impact of immigration on local communities.
task2.topic: How immigration affects local economic growth and community development
task2.instructions: Choose one of the viewpoints below or present your own. Support your choice with reasons and examples.
viewpoints: Immigration brings diverse skills and drives economic growth in communities
Rapid immigration can strain local services and housing availability
Communities need better integration programs to maximize the benefits of immigration

task2.title: Four-Day Work Week
task2.prompt: Respond to a survey about whether companies should adopt a four-day work week.
task2.topic: The potential benefits and challenges of reducing the standard work week
task2.instructions: Choose one of the viewpoints below or present your own. Support your choice with reasons and examples.
viewpoints: A four-day week increases productivity and employee well-being
Most businesses cannot operate effectively with reduced hours
It should be optional for companies to decide based on their industry

task2.title: Electric Vehicles
task2.prompt: Respond to a survey about whether the government should offer larger incentives for electric vehicle purchases.
task2.topic: Government policy on promoting electric vehicle adoption
task2.instructions: Choose one of the viewpoints below or present your own. Support your choice with reasons and examples.
viewpoints: Larger incentives are needed to accelerate the transition to clean transportation
The market should decide without government intervention in vehicle choices
Investment in public transit is more effective than subsidizing individual car purchases

task2.title: Local Food Production
task2.prompt: Respond to a survey about whether the city should support urban farming initiatives.
task2.topic: The role of urban agriculture in food security and community building
task2.instructions: Choose one of the viewpoints below or present your own. Support your choice with reasons and examples.
viewpoints: Urban farms provide fresh food and build community connections
The space would be better used for affordable housing or businesses
Community gardens are good but should not receive significant public funding

task2.title: Pet Ownership in Apartments
task2.prompt: Respond to a survey about whether apartment buildings should allow pets.
task2.topic: Pet policies in multi-unit residential buildings
task2.instructions: Choose one of the viewpoints below or present your own. Support your choice with reasons and examples.
viewpoints: All buildings should allow pets as they are important for mental health
Building owners should have the right to set no-pet policies
Pets should be allowed with reasonable restrictions on size and noise

task2.title: Library Services Modernization
task2.prompt: Respond to a survey about how public libraries should adapt to the digital age.
task2.topic: The evolving role of public libraries in the digital era
task2.instructions: Choose one of the viewpoints below or present your own. Support your choice with reasons and examples.
viewpoints: Libraries should focus on digital resources like e-books, online databases, and computer labs
Physical books and quiet reading spaces should remain the primary focus
Libraries should transform into community hubs offering workshops, coworking spaces, and cultural events

task2.title: Tipping Culture
task2.prompt: Respond to a survey about whether restaurants should eliminate tipping and pay higher wages instead.
task2.topic: The debate over tipping versus fair base wages in the service industry
task2.instructions: Choose one of the viewpoints below or present your own. Support your choice with reasons and examples.
viewpoints: Tipping should be eliminated and workers should receive fair hourly wages
Tipping motivates better service and allows workers to earn more than a fixed wage
A service charge should be included in prices with tips remaining optional
